title: Find the currency sign bug
goal: Find which function mis-places the sign when formatting negative currency and report the exact wrong and right output for -150 cents.
prompt: This repository has a bug in how it formats negative currency amounts. Find the function responsible, explain why it is wrong, and state exactly what `formatCurrencyCents(-150)` currently returns and what it should return instead. Write your findings to ANSWER.md (create it; do not change any other file).
